cards.p: An advertising campaign is a chain: Amazon shows your ad, producing impressions; some shoppers click; some clicks become orders.
Its CTR is 0.30% against an account CTR of 0.70%, less than half.
At a 10% ad conversion rate, 22 clicks with no sale is the first point at which zero stops being an ordinary result.
Six things you can work through in a week. Twenty you cannot.
